scope: Defined v1: a shared engine and GUI, qualified Python/Windows, Android and .NET builds, and foundations for Linux/macOS runners. 100% covers this release scope; support for additional languages and formats has a separate roadmap.

items.title: v1 scope, instructions and measurable completion criteria
evidence: README.md and ROADMAP.md: scope, limitations and fixed v1 weights

items.title: Engine, adapter and runner boundaries
evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: job workflow, responsibilities and result model

items.title: Installable package and working CLI entry point
